text:
nisha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — converting remediation items into tests so owners have clear acceptance criteria.
raphael: Please paste the high level RCAs so we can map guardrails.
nisha: RCAs: 1) KV eviction backlog during short bursts, 2) tokenizer divergence on quant builds causing fallback mismatches, 3) prompt canonicalization dropping non-printing chars.
toni: I'll own (1). Plan: add a `burst-short-2min` load profile + a KV eviction chaos attack. Make it a smoke CI job for staging.
raphael: I'll own (2). Create a deterministic quant-vs-baseline eval: 180 prompt pairs, fixed seed, temperature=0, compare token-level diff and BLEU-style similarity. Gate threshold 1.3%.
nisha: I'll curate the incident promptset (owner: nisha) 100 examples (70 from traces + 30 synthetics) and add unit tests for canonicalization. Path: eng-ml/evals/promptsets/pm-2026-burst-canonical.
toni: Chaos snippet I'd run locally and then add to the harness:
```
chaosctl run --attack kv-evict --pool=serve-canary --profile=burst-short-2min --duration=10m --collect=eviction-lag,cache-miss
```
qa-bot: Reminder: open follow-up ticket with labels `incident-followup` and `tests-needed`. Use template `pm->testplan` and attach owners.
raphael: CI plan: add `eval/quant-compare` GitHub Action that runs nightly for 7 days after merge and posts JSON summary to #eng-ml-evals. If gate trips it auto-creates an Issue `eval/regression` and tags owners.
nisha: Timeline proposal: KV smoke in 48h (toni), promptset PR in 72h (nisha), quant eval PR in 5 days (raphael), CI guard and rollback link in 2 weeks (raphael).
toni: Also propose adding `burst-short-2min` to the weekly soak matrix and a monthly targeted run since we've seen this pattern recur.
triage-bot: Noted: pattern frequency flagged. Recommend monthly soak + oncall playbook addendum.
nisha: I'll open the follow-up ticket and add checklist items:
- [ ] KV chaos smoke (toni)
- [ ] Promptset added (nisha)
- [ ] Quant eval CI (raphael)
- [ ] Rollout guard + rollback link (raphael)

raphael: I'll draft the eval runner to persist raw outputs for forensic diffs and include deterministic ordering.
toni: Starting KV smoke now; will post artifacts to the ticket when done.
qa-bot: When PR merges, run `eval/quant-compare` nightly for 7 days and post summaries.
nisha: Thanks everyone 1 I'll post one-line status updates here as items land so we can close the follow-up ticket quickly. :thumbsup:
